body.name: Exact contact-set Palm declustering rule and handle
body.construction: At level \(u\ge1\), use contact cutoff \(R(u)=u^2\), mesh \(\Delta(u)=u^{-4}\), run radius \(\rho(u)=4R(u)\), and run count \(q(u)=\lceil\rho(u)/\Delta(u)\rceil\). Declare a mesh exceedance to be a cluster root exactly when the translated event \(A_u\) occurs. The proof handle is Palm conditioning on \(A_u\) followed by small-noise analysis of the constrained and unconstrained GCM contact-set energy and translation mode.
